title: Best Day to Sell
statement: You track the price of a game skin for several days. You may buy it on one day and sell it on a later day. Return the largest profit you can make, or 0 if no profit is possible.

answerKey.pattern: Single pass keeping the lowest price so far and the best profit
keyPoints: Keep the lowest price seen before the current day
For each day, profit = price - lowest so far; keep the best
Update the lowest price after checking the profit
Return the best profit, which starts at 0
edgeCases: The lowest price comes after the highest price
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Try every buy and sell pair: O(n^2)

hints: Checking every buy and sell pair is O(n^2). What do you need to know about the days before today?
Remember the lowest price so far; selling today earns today's price minus that low.
Start the best profit at 0 so that falling prices give 0, not a negative number.
